title: DBP K210 deacetylation suppresses BmNPV proliferation and promotes apoptosis associated with altered BmIAP regulation.
authors: Yang, Siyi; Sun, Yidong; Li, Wenjing; Tariq, Komal; Gao, Jie; Wang, Dajin; Miao, Meng; Yu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BmNPV病毒DNA结合蛋白DBP的K210去乙酰化修饰对病毒复制和宿主凋亡的影响，涉及DBP与宿主BmIAP启动子的结合调控，但核心是病毒-宿主互作而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，且方法以实验为主，无AI或物理模拟。
abstract: The DNA-binding protein DBP, encoded by ORF16 of Bombyx mori nucleopolyhedrovirus (BmNPV), is a single-stranded DNA-binding protein expressed early during infection and is essential for efficient viral replication. Although DBP has been proposed to function as a transcriptional regulator, the mechanisms governing its activity remain poorly understood. In our previous study, a quantitative acetylproteomic analysis identified acetylation at lysine 210 (K210) of DBP during BmNPV infection, with its acetylation level increasing approximately 1.7-fold at 36 h post-infection. To investigate the functional significance of this modification, we generated a DBP deficient BmNPV mutant and BmNPV mutants carrying DBP substitutions designed to mimic acetylation or deacetylation at K210. No infectious virus production was detected following loss of DBP, whereas the K210 deacetylation-mimetic mutant showed markedly reduced progeny virus production, accompanied by reduced viral DNA replication and expression of the viral genes examined. Chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) analysis revealed that the K210 deacetylation-mimetic mutation altered the genomic binding profile of DBP and was associated with changes in host genes involved in apoptosis and cell-cycle regulation. Among them, the binding ability to the apoptosis inhibitor BmIAP decreased after the deacetylation simulation mutation. ChIP-qPCR confirmed DBP enrichment at the IAP promoter, while dual-luciferase assays demonstrated that K210 deacetylation reduced IAP promoter activity. Consistent with these findings, the DBP deacetylation-mimetic mutant increased caspase-3 activity and the expression of the pro-apoptotic genes examined while reducing that of an anti-apoptotic gene. Importantly, overexpression of BmIAP partially attenuated caspase-3 activity and the changes in apoptosis-related transcript levels associated with expression of the DBP deacetylation-mimetic mutant, supporting a contributory role for BmIAP in the observed apoptotic phenotype. Together, these findings support a regulatory role for DBP K210 acetylation in BmNPV replication and suggest that DBP K210 deacetylation is associated with enhanced apoptotic responses, at least partly through modulation of BmIAP expression, providing new insights into the molecular interplay between baculoviruses and their insect hosts.
abstract_zh: DNA结合蛋白DBP由家蚕核型多角体病毒（BbmNPV）的ORF16编码，是一种在感染早期表达的单链DNA结合蛋白，对高效病毒复制至关重要。尽管DBP被认为可能作为转录调控因子发挥作用，但调控其活性的机制仍知之甚少。在我们先前的研究中，定量乙酰化蛋白质组学分析鉴定出家蚕核型多角体病毒感染期间DBP赖氨酸210（K210）位点的乙酰化，其乙酰化水平在感染后36小时增加约1.7倍。为探究该修饰的功能意义，我们构建了DBP缺陷型BmNPV突变体以及携带DBP K210位点模拟乙酰化或去乙酰化替代的BmNPV突变体。DBP缺失后未检测到感染性病毒产生，而K210去乙酰化模拟突变体则表现出子代病毒产量显著降低，并伴随病毒DNA复制及所检测病毒基因表达的减少。染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）分析显示，K210去乙酰化模拟突变改变了DBP的基因组结合谱，并与涉及细胞凋亡和细胞周期调控的宿主基因变化相关。其中，去乙酰化模拟突变后，对凋亡抑制因子BmIAP的结合能力下降。ChIP-qPCR证实DBP在IAP启动子处富集，而双荧光素酶实验表明K210去乙酰化降低了IAP启动子活性。与这些发现一致，DBP去乙酰化模拟突变体增加了caspase-3活性及所检测促凋亡基因的表达，同时降低了抗凋亡基因的表达。重要的是，BmIAP的过表达部分减弱了与DBP去乙酰化模拟突变体表达相关的caspase-3活性及凋亡相关转录水平的变化，支持BmIAP在观察到的凋亡表型中发挥贡献作用。综上，这些发现支持DBP K210乙酰化在BmNPV复制中的调控作用，并提示DBP K210去乙酰化与增强的凋亡反应相关，至少部分通过调节BmIAP表达实现，为杆状病毒与其昆虫宿主之间的分子相互作用提供了新见解。
